does.text: Queues a request: a 16-bit key and an ecl::tutorial::UILayerRequest (a list of entries carrying two FixedStrings and a flag). The callers are UI code: in the macOS build gui::DCWidget::OnTutorialLayerCommand and gui::TutorialManager::OnStateActivated / OnStateDeactivated; on Windows three NoesisGameUI.dll functions.
does.evidence: EoCClient.dll+0x638AB0 ecl::tutorial::UILayerSystem::LEGACY_Request (signature short, UILayerRequest const &); callers by gatekit decomp grep: bg3_macos_x64+0x2933EC0, +0x2BC27D0, +0x2BC2A50; NoesisGameUI.dll+0x1DA2A0, +0x1DA390, +0x7791E0.
does.check: not checkable live: queuing leaves nothing in the ECS; what it leads to is checked on Update.

does.text: When requests are queued, for each one the system looks for an entity whose ecl::tutorial::UILayerComponent's first field (Layer, int16) equals the request's key. If none is found it creates an entity, adds UILayerComponent and stores the key in it. It then appends to the component's Entries every entry of the request whose flag byte is 0 (the two FixedStrings), rebuilds the component's FixedString set (field_18) from the Entries, and adds ecl::tutorial::UILayerChangedOneFrameComponent to that entity. The queue is cleared after the loop.
does.evidence: EoCClient.dll+0x638E00 ecl::tutorial::UILayerSystem::Update: the test of the request count at this+0x3C, the Persistent/Alive walk comparing the int16 at stride 0x48 with the request's short, the invalid-handle branch with CreateEntity and the adder FUN_180637850 (type-index global DAT_1819da8f8 = ecl::tutorial::UILayerComponent), the loop over 12-byte entries (FixedStrings at 0 and 4) skipping those with the byte at 8 set, the set cleared and refilled from the array, the adder FUN_180637660 (DAT_1819da8f0 = ecl::tutorial::UILayerChangedOneFrameComponent), and the clear at the end.
